title: This GitHub Tool Cuts AI Agent Token Costs by 40%
description:
Your AI agent might be wasting tokens right now and you probaly don't even notice it 🔥

There's a tool on GitHub called ax, a web scraper made specifically for AI agents. Normaly when your agent hits the web it gets back raw HTML, hundreds of kilobytes of junk that just clog up the context. ax gives back only what actually matters: page structure, the real data, tables, all in a compact form.

The author benchmarked it on real Claude Code sessions and token costs droped by around forty percent on average 😅 that's not a small number.

Search GitHub for yusukebe ax if you wanna try it ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
